Lena Ortiz: Meridian AI sent back the SOW. They want 70% off for first 30 days, waive setup fee, and Net75. Asking if we can make an exception.

Caleb Rivers: Who's the account owner and what's the expected monthly usage/ARR?

Lena Ortiz: Owner: Caleb (AE). Pilot 1 month, est 10M tokens but strategic partner w/ integration potential. They said if pilot looks good they may commit to a dedicated cluster in 2027.

Omar Khan: Finance note: 70% is well outside pilot concession policy. Net75 is unheard of for new logos. We need clear justification for collections & cashflow exposure. Any PO or parent company guarantee?

Lena Ortiz: Customer offered a PO but legal insists on Net75 because their internal procurement cycles are slow. They also want us to mark setup as waived on the invoice.

Nina Patel: RevenueOps: We strongly prefer to invoice full list and apply a one-time contra credit for waiver. That keeps AR aging and revenue recognition clean. For Net75, we can consider it with an approved receivables instrument (e.g., promissory PO + credit holdback) and VP-Finance approval.

Omar Khan: Policy recap: Finance can approve up to 40% pilot discount for new logos without exec sign-off. Anything above that requires VP-Finance/CFO sign-off and documented mitigations for DSO risk. Net75 requires VP-Finance sign-off + collections plan.

Lena Ortiz: Sales proposal to move forward quickly:
```
Item: Pilot access (10M tokens) - list $1,200/mo
Requested: 70% off month 1, waive $3k setup, Net75 billing
Finance counter: 40% off month 1, $1.5k one-time onboarding credit (contra), Net30 billing. If customer insists on Net75, require PO + VP-Finance approval + $15k credit cap and 30/60 day review.
```

Caleb Rivers: Sales can accept 40% + $1.5k credit and will push for PO and Net30. If they insist on Net75, I'll ask for a corporate guarantee or escalate.

approvals-bot: Approval ticket APP-5234 created and routed to Omar Khan + VP-Finance. Summary: Meridian AI pilot pricing/term exception (70% off + Net75 request). Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-5234

Omar Khan: I'll run a fast credit check and schedule for VP review. Collections to prep conditional payment terms if approved.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks all 60a; holding signature until APP-5234 resolved.
